text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday chaired a cabinet meeting on women and family protection, which discussed easing procedures for low-income devorced women to get their pensions.
- The Mediterranean exhibition "SAMEST 97" organized by the Tunisian Agency of the Promotion of Industry (API) will be held from September 24 to 26.
- Mobile health caravans provided health care for more than 32,000 people in the rural areas in July.
- Tunisia to celebrate the Women's Day on August 13.
